mission_07: Great work! You have implemented TransE knowledge graph embeddings, representing entities and relations as vectors where valid triplets satisfy h + r ≈ t. Your implementation learns embeddings through margin-based ranking, ensuring that true triplets score lower than corrupted ones. The translation-based scoring enables link prediction: given a head and relation, you can rank candidate tails by their translation distance. Knowledge graph embeddings are foundational for neuro-symbolic AI, providing a bridge between symbolic knowledge graphs (with their explicit structure) and neural representations (with their ability to generalize and handle uncertainty). TransE's simplicity makes it a starting point for more complex models like RotatE, ComplEx, and ConvE.
